about: OH product feed, first build: LG's real products by their real SKUs, names, prices and images, as lg.com/us showed them to an anonymous visitor on 2026-10-01 (docs/lg/research/lg-taxonomy.json). Catalog CONTENT, never in the content catalog: the engine never decides a price; attributes travel on events and on POST /sort, keyed by the dimension names of design §3 (docs/lg/OH-Demo-Design.md). Companions are relations written by OUR merchandiser's rules (companionRules), shown as rules. Derivation rules and what the crawl lacked: docs/lg/lanes/D1.md.
source: docs/lg/research/lg-taxonomy.json (meta.seen 2026-10-01; products{}, categoryAttributes{}, the listing nodes' listedOn)
priceRule: salePrice and listPrice are the crawl's, never computed: the listing card's sale and struck list price; the schema.org row's sale price where no card was seen (0 or absent → null); the product-page variant selector for sizes and colours the listings did not show; the card text for seven Sound Suite rows whose own price is the first card's, copied by the crawl. A price is the same for everyone: nothing here varies by place or by person.
ctaRule: cart: the card showed Add to Cart (inStock true) or Notify Me (inStock false: sold here, out of stock). retailer: the card showed Find a Retailer, or no card was seen (we never claim the cart where the crawl did not see it). bestBuyPickup: the card showed "Est. In-Store Pickup".
imageRule: image is the crawl's LG media-host link where the listing's schema.org row carried one, else null for Lane D2 to fill under public/oh/img/** with its manifest.
familyRule: family is the product family a product page asserts as ctx.family; catalog pieces gate companions and offers on it (eligibleWhen.context.family), failing closed. The same page asserts ctx.anchor = the row's sku, which the engine's complements rule reads (a piece whose complements lists that sku is preferred, with a completes line on the receipt). modelFamily (laundry) is LG's model number family that pairs a washer with its dryers.

dimensions.note: Sixteen dimensions (design §3). Products carry fourteen; intent and contentType are carried by catalog pieces and by asserted context. Multi-valued on products: feature, package, retailer (at most 8 values each).
dimensions.sizeBandRule: TV size from the SKU's inch digits, banded by LG's own Screen Size filter (27–41, 42–54, 55–64, 65–74, 75–82, 83–120). Appliances carry a size band only where the crawl states a width.
dimensions.capacityTierRule: cu. ft. from the crawl's name, a laundry set's name, a product-page spec, a colour variant's name, or (ranges, microwaves) the SKU's capacity digits; tiered per category: washers by LG's Capacity filter bands (≤4.1 compact, 4.2–4.6 standard, 4.7–5.1 large, 5.2+ extra-large); dryers ≤6.9 compact, 7.0–7.4 standard, 7.5–7.9 large, 8.0+ extra-large; ranges ≤5.4, ≤5.9, ≤6.5, more; microwaves ≤1.6, ≤1.8, ≤2.1, more.
dimensions.priceTierRule: Category-relative: quartiles of the crawl's sale prices within the category (priceCuts); ≤ q1 good, ≤ median better, ≤ q3 best, above flagship. No price → no tier.

companionRules.note: "Goes with" is our merchandiser's rule, shown as one; every list is ordered in stock first, sold here first, same finish first, then by review count.
companionRules.dryers: washer → dryers of the same series (LG's model number: electric NNNN, gas NNNN+1, heat pump NNNN+2, as the WM6500HWA and DLEX4000B pages and the laundry sets pair them), split by fuel; same colour first
companionRules.washers: dryer → the washers of its series
companionRules.pedestals: front-load only: the WDP6 drawer and WD300 SideKick in the washer's colour (the crawl's laundry sets pair them so), then any pedestal in that colour; a top-loader has no pedestal
companionRules.stackingKits: front-load pairs: KSTK4, the kit the WM6500HWA and DLEX4000B pages name; none for LG SIGNATURE (the crawl names none) or compact machines
companionRules.soundbars: TV → soundbars in the TV series' tier: OLED G, W, M, T and Micro RGB flagship; OLED C and QNED 9-series best; OLED B, QNED 8-series and lifestyle better; the rest good. Soundbar tiers are the soundbars' own price quartiles. QNED TVs lead with the S70TY, which its page marks "Designed for QNED TV"
companionRules.mounts: TV → wall mounts listing the TV's VESA pattern; only the OLED65C6PUA's pattern (300 x 200) is in the crawl
companionRules.microwaves: range or dishwasher → over-the-range microwaves LG packages with it, then the same finish family and line
companionRules.dishwashers: range or microwave → dishwashers LG packages with it, then the same finish family and line
companionRules.ranges: microwave or dishwasher → ranges LG packages with it, then the same finish family and line
companionRules.packages: the kitchen packages and laundry sets this product is a member of
companionRules.members: package → its member SKUs, in LG's order; memberSum and savings only when every member's price is in the crawl

template.rule: best sellers by review count, the site's own merchandising order, not personalised
template.how: review count, then rating, highest first; one row per model (rows sharing a review pool count as one; a TV at 65 inches where that size qualifies, otherwise its lowest-priced row); only rows the page can show whole and sell here: an OH image, a price (specs.json's, as the page merges it), not Find a Retailer only, not out of stock. Data from the crawl's cards (reviews, ratings) and the product pages (price, button); the same for every visitor.
template.recommendedNote: twelve for the boot page's "Recommended for you": the four best-selling TVs, then four laundry, then four kitchen
template.gridDefaultsNote: the TV grid's order before any visitor exists: the eight best-selling TVs by the same rule (bestSellers.living-room also holds soundbars)
